analysis.rootCauseHypothesis:
The failure likely stems from incomplete or inconsistent UI semantics in the hosted service: the settings dialog exposes selectors whose mutability is ambiguous, while the page does not provide enough deterministic evidence for filter/location agreement, button-label meaning, or the rationale for disabled/dead entries. As a result, the audit automation could not conclusively verify those assertions, even though the visible navigation/content appeared correct. The agent did not verify all requested audit assertions. In particular, it left settings-control changeability unresolved and did not document checks of filter/location agreement, button-label semantics, or dead/disabled entries and their explanations, so the audit cannot be considered complete.

The most likely cause is a state propagation bug: the selected folders/projects are not being carried into the question view, so the page initializes with the default total-library scope. This can happen if the route/navigation payload drops the selection, the store is reset on page transition, or the backend ignores/overrides the scope filter and returns all materials. The selected-material question view did not show a bounded scope for the selected folders. It showed the total library instead.

Observations:
- The final folder-scope view displayed “总资料库 · 市场部 · 选中 22 份资料.”
- The earlier selected-project scope view also displayed a total-library scope rather than confirming the selected projects.

recommendedFixTarget.rationale: The service is likely resolving the question view scope from a default/global library context instead of the user's selected folder/project context. Update the hosting-side state flow so the selected scope is persisted and propagated into the question page before render (e.g., from the folder/project picker to the question view route/store/API request). Ensure the UI does not fall back to “总资料库” when a valid scoped selection exists. If the scope is derived server-side, pass the selected folder/project IDs in the request and have the backend return the bounded document set and matching label. Add validation to prevent showing the question view until scope initialization completes, and add tests for selected-project and selected-folder navigation to confirm the displayed scope matches the selection.
